name: Reaper scythe
scale_note: Measured off the 374x534 px concept: 515 px from knob to butt = 1.80 m, so 1 px = 3.5 mm. Model faces -Y; the blade sweeps to -X as in the concept.

materials.name: HeadIron
materials.notes: collar block, darker than the blade

materials.name: SkullBone
materials.notes: skull boss, same metal family, darker

build: Shaft: 3-strand twisted sweep, radius 25 mm, along a wandering path through the concept's centreline (top x=+0.01 m, bulge to +0.14 m at 0.95 m height, back to +0.07 m at the butt), 1.62 m long, about 4 twists per metre.
Head: block 0.23 m wide x 0.15 m tall x 0.065 m deep at the top of the shaft, with a pointed tang running +X and a short square knob on top.
Skull: boss on the front face of the head, 55 mm tall, cranium plus jaw, dark sockets.
Blade: extruded crescent, 12 mm thick, from the head's left face sweeping -X and down to a tip 0.48 m left of the shaft and 0.27 m below the head top; back edge convex, cutting edge concave.
